bundleGuards.finding: The guard passes because main.tsx reaches the prototype only through a dynamic import() of the gateEntry chunk, which never joins the start chunks of the Welcome screen. It says nothing about a merged, statically reachable simulation.

note: The delta covers the two libraries (three and jolt-physics) only, with no part and no asset. It is renderer dist/ output (js, wasm and source maps; hashed file names are matched after stripping the hash), not an installer. No baseline Electron package was built (too slow), so installer growth per platform is not measured; unpackedLinuxBytes is the du -sb of the spike dist-electron/linux-unpacked, built from 6b92110f plus the bench files.
